notes.note: #5053: checked the ledger, delivery-status and shutdown claims against UsageTelemetryService. A retryable failure keeps the batch queued and writes no ledger record; a batch is recorded once when it leaves the queue (sent/acknowledged, or dropped with rejected, off, overflow or shutdown transport). failedAttempts counts each failed request; withdrawn/shutdownDropped/rejected/overflowDropped count each event once; both shutdown paths record shutdown_dropped.
